question: How many days moon takes to revolve around the earth?
solution:
The correct answer is option __2__, i.e. __**27(1)/(3)__****.**

__
 
• There are two periods involved with the orbit of the Moon around the Earth.
 
• The Moon appears to move completely around the celestial sphere once in about **27.3**__** **days as observed from the Earth.
 
• This is called a sidereal month and represents the orbital period of the Moon around the Earth. 
 
• The Moon takes **29.5** days to return to the same point on the celestial sphere as referenced to the Sun because of the motion of the Earth around the Sun.
 
• This is called a synodic month (lunar phases as observed from the Earth are correlated with the synodic month).
